statLabel: Annualised existing-home sales in October, the slowest pace since 2010
facts: Sales fell 5.5% from September and 8.8% from a year earlier
Median price $416,700, up 0.4% year on year
Supply rose to 5.1 months, the highest since 2015
source: Source: National Association of Realtors, via Real Estate News, 12 Nov 2026
caption:
US real estate: existing-home sales fell to a 3.75 million annual pace in October, the slowest since 2010.

Sales were down 8.8% from a year earlier, while the median price edged up 0.4% to $416,700. Supply rose to 5.1 months.

Source: National Association of Realtors, via Real Estate News (12 Nov 2026). Market news, not investment advice.
